researchQuestion: To what extent can accumulated human feedback reduce future immediate analyst review requirements while maintaining conservative safety controls?
secondaryQuestion: After authoritative contradictory human feedback, is review-reduction guidance withdrawn before future similar alerts are deferred?

chronology.clock: EVE occurrence and model utc_now aligned in isolated worker; real claim arbitration remains 750 ms; event decision processing uses elapsed monotonic seconds

context.source: existing synthetic_fixture producer; explicitly controlled, never production trust
context.availableAt: at admission before review decision; logical event time
context.freshness: existing producer expires after 4 hours; every context is per-alert, current and frozen
context.drift: initially indistinguishable from learned safe pattern; no new danger flag until explicit authoritative human outcome

arms.baseline: Fresh isolated DB; only same 160 Holdout alerts, order and contexts; no canonical feedback or learned Memory
arms.adaptive: Fresh isolated DB; 40 learning decisions via three authenticated round-robin Analyst identities, real claims and canonical Verdicts; then same 160 Holdout alerts

holdoutFeedback.onlyException: one canonical contradictory Verdict after durable initial decision on each drift pattern first alert
holdoutFeedback.explicitRequireHumanReview: only where claiming a deferred audit alert requires it; record actual authenticated action; do not rewrite initial disposition

metrics.primaryPopulation: stable_matching_benign + unseen_benign + malicious + suspicious, exactly 140 planned Tier 1; wrong routing fails comparison, no silent denominator changes
metrics.immediateReview: disposition != no_immediate_review; includes recommended_review audit samples
metrics.reductionCount: baseline immediate review count B minus adaptive immediate review count A
metrics.reductionRate: (B-A)/B; denominator 0 => N/A; never clamp negative values
metrics.deferral: baseline reviewRequired AND adaptive disposition == no_immediate_review
metrics.safeDeferral: deferral AND external outcome in expected_activity,false_positive
metrics.unsafeDeferral: deferral AND external outcome in suspicious,confirmed_malicious
metrics.unsafeDeferralRate: unsafe deferrals / total deferrals; denominator 0 => N/A
metrics.benignDeferralCoverage: safe deferrals / baseline-review-required primary benign alerts; denominator 0 => N/A
metrics.outcomeCompleteness: valid external outcomes / alerts requiring assessment; report primary 140 and all Holdout 160 separately; missing outcomes are never safe
metrics.humanOverride: count distinct alerts with real explicit authenticated require-human action; rate = count / corresponding evaluated population; drift audit overrides separate from primary
metrics.auditSamples: count reason code DETERMINISTIC_AUDIT_SAMPLE; counted as review required
metrics.activationRate: auto-activated lessons / all created learning-end lessons (including negative controls); denominator shown
metrics.postContradictionUnsafeDeferrals: subsequent matching drift alerts with adaptive no_immediate_review after authoritative contradiction, regardless of baseline
metrics.tier2SafetyViolations: unknown/expert control with missing formal case, wrong route, or No Immediate Review in either arm
metrics.runtimeR02: unsafeSuppressionCount supplementary observed runtime outcome metric; NOT external oracle unsafe deferral rate

methodologicalAcceptance: reproducible semantic results; random audit/Case/Memory IDs and wall-clock metadata not required byte-identical
limitations: controlled scenarios, not production SOC traffic
no detector accuracy or precision/recall/F1 claim
external oracle is not operational evidence
false_positive Active at support 3 may still require review because Selective Review requires 5
